Not a governed path, under 3000 lines, so Tier S landing by the seat. 45 existing items re-pointed (each with a revision bump and history row) and one new item, `platform-core.package-export-round-trip`.

(2) `permission-matrix-editor-ux` A5 is not applied: the code at base draws the expander on every row with no read-only gate, so the card's line is not adopted without a live re-check. (3) The 4 `offclause.zh-cn-studio-save-29790` lines have no ledger item to land on.
- **Out of scope:** three more stale lines the dev found are filed as #30129 (`finding`). The `picklist-bound-select` fixture line landed here, so #29819 skips it. `Skills-docs:` n/a, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Landing:** `skip-changeset` (docs/QA ledger only). Ready, then auto-merge through the merge queue.
